events.title: 아스널 remain four points ahead at the top of the First Division with a 3–1 home win over 윔블던, as 에버턴 keep up the pressure with a 3–0 home win over 애스턴 빌라. 맨체스터 유나이티드's upswing continues with a 4–1 home win over 뉴캐슬 유나이티드. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 climb back into the top half of the table by beating 레스터 시티 4–1 at Upton Park. 첼시 continue their recent revival with a 3–1 win over 퀸스 파크 레인저스 in a West London derby clash at Stamford Bridge .

Steve Moran scores a hat-trick in 레스터 시티's 6–1 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이, which lifts the East Midlands side off the bottom of the First Division. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, who lose 2–1 at home to 코번트리 시티, now prop up the table. 에버턴 keep up the pressure on 아스널 with a 1–0 win over 퀸스 파크 레인저스 at Loftus Road .
아스널 beat 토트넘 홋스퍼 2–1 at White Hart Lane in the North London derby to go four points ahead at the top of the league.
Ian Snodin joins 에버턴 for £840,000 from 리즈 유나이티드.
맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 맨체스터 시티 1–0 in the FA Cup third round at Old Trafford .
노팅엄 포리스트 are surprisingly beaten 2–1 by 크리스털 팰리스 in the FA Cup third round.

Winger Peter Barnes becomes the second 맨체스터 유나이티드 player to transfer to neighbours City this season when he completes his £30,000 return to the club where he started his career more than a decade ago.

에버턴 and 리버풀 both keep up the pressure on leaders 아스널. Howard Kendall 's men beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 2–0 at Goodison Park, while 케니 달글리시 's defending champions beat 맨체스터 시티 1–0 at Maine Road. In the Second Division, 브래드퍼드 시티 boost their survival bid with a 4–0 home win over 밀월, whose promotion hopes take a major blow as a result.
첼시 sign 23-year-old defender 스티브 클라크 from 세인트 미렌 for £400,000. The gap at the top of the First Division remains at two points when 아스널 draw 0–0 at home to 코번트리 시티.
포츠머스 striker Micky Quinn is found guilty on a double charge of driving while disqualified and receives a 21-day prison sentence.
The country's biggest anti-hooliganism police operation sees 26 suspected football hooligans arrested in raids in the West Midlands and Southern England .
리버풀's £250,000 move for 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 defender Derek Statham falls through after the player fails a fitness test.

아스널 lose 2–0 away to 맨체스터 유나이티드, their first League defeat since September. Other key games include 웨스트햄 유나이티드's 3–1 win over 코번트리 시티 at Highfield Road , 왓퍼드 winning by the same scoreline at 옥스퍼드 유나이티드, and 토트넘 홋스퍼's 3–0 home win over 애스턴 빌라.
에버턴 miss the chance to go top of the First Division by losing 1–0 at 노팅엄 포리스트.

리버풀 sign 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 striker John Aldridge , 28, for a fee of £750,000 as player-manager 케니 달글리시 ends his search for a new striker ready to take over from 이언 러시 , who will leave for 유벤투스 at the end of the season.
루턴 타운 knock holders 리버풀 out of the FA Cup with a comprehensive 3–0 victory in the third round second replay at Kenilworth Road.
Out-of-favour 아스널 defender Tommy Caton leaves the club after three years and signs for 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 in a £100,000 deal.

In the FA Cup fourth round, 코번트리 시티 win 1–0 away to 맨체스터 유나이티드, while 아스널 put six goals past 플리머스 아가일 at Highbury . The Gunners remain top of the First Division as the month ends, with 에버턴 and 리버풀 their nearest contenders and 노팅엄 포리스트 occupying fourth place. 애스턴 빌라 have slipped back into the relegation zone, joining 레스터 시티 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드. 포츠머스 are still top of the Second Division with 더비 카운티 in second place. The play-off places are occupied by 올덤 애슬레틱, 입스위치 타운 and 플리머스 아가일.
